    Chemistry tab

    Choose the gas species, solid species, and reactions that belong to this case. Definitions can come from the built-in catalogue or the project's plugins.

    Species and reaction controls

    Field or option What it does
    Gas species / Solid species Lists the species definitions included in this case, with their sources.
    + Add gas species… / + Add solid species… Opens the picker for that phase. Added species start at zero in compositions or solid loadings.
    + Add reaction families… Makes the chosen reaction families available in the case.
    Reaction checkbox Includes or excludes that individual reaction from execution.
    + Species Adds a family's missing required species, with zero initial fractions/loadings.
    Bindings… Opens a selector for each reaction role so you can choose the matching case component.
    Each role selector in Bindings Chooses among compatible selected species; useful when several variants describe the same chemical.

    Available species, families, reactions, and binding roles depend on the selected definitions and installed project plugins. Their names and descriptions appear in the picker and hover details.

    Reaction graph controls

    Control or symbol What it does or means
    Click a node Highlights its immediate neighbours and connections; click again or on empty space to clear.
    Green / copper / neutral nodes Gas species / solid species / reactions.
    Red nodes Species required by the selected chemistry but missing from the case.
    Dashed links Catalysts or rate dependencies.

    Build the chemistry

    1. Add the gas and solid species you need. Check each definition's source when several variants describe the same chemical.
    2. Use + Add reaction families… to make the required models available.
    3. Check the individual reactions that should run. A family's + Species action adds missing components required by its reactions.
    4. Inspect Bindings… when a reaction role could refer to more than one selected component.
    5. Set gas fractions in Program and solid loadings in Bed. Newly added species start at zero in those inputs.

    Selecting a family and selecting its reactions are separate steps. Rates from overlapping selected models add together, so remove an unwanted model when replacing it with another.

    Inspect the reaction graph

    Click a node to highlight its neighbours and connections. Click it again, or click empty space, to clear the highlight. Scroll or use + / − to zoom, drag to pan, and use Fit to show the whole graph.

    Removing a species also removes its entries from compositions and bed zones. Review those tabs after changing the species list.
